column9: Crawler Notes
GME hub links to separate residency and fellowship lists; program pages commonly expose current trainees.
Single GME page lists 125+ programs by campus and links to program pages. No public employee-wide directory found.

column3: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center
column9: Official program search is useful as a seed; trainee pages are split across campus and department sites, including blog.ttuhsc.edu.

column3: University of Arizona College of Medicine – Tucson
column9: Tucson GME hub covers 60+ programs. Campus directory points to this phonebook for person searches.
Program directory is the best crawler seed; provider finder is not an employee-wide directory.
Training pages often route to Columbia or Weill Cornell program sites; crawler should allow those official affiliated domains.
Central GME page links to a training-opportunities search across member hospitals.

column3: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences (UAMS)
column9: Official College of Medicine GME list is the best starting point for specialty pages.

column3: University of New Mexico School of Medicine
column9: Public UNM directory supports faculty/staff filtering; GME page links to residency and fellowship programs.
Central program index plus public university/medical-center people search.
ODU GME page lists residencies and fellowships; some legacy links still use evms.edu.

column3: University of Virginia School of Medicine
column9: Official GME program index and UVA people directory.
Residency/fellowship index is a useful crawl seed; directory may limit some details to authenticated users.
Central education page lists residencies and fellowships; no public employee-wide directory found.
Residency hub is public; fellowship links may be under individual hospital or specialty pages.

column3: University of Wisconsin–Madison School of Medicine and Public Health
column9: GME page provides program access; campus directory includes people search.
GME hub links to training programs; provider finder is the public directory available without login.

column3: Dartmouth Health / Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center
column9: Dedicated residents-and-fellows site; Dartmouth directory is institution-wide but may not include every health-system trainee.

column3: Albany Medical College / Albany Medical Center
column9: Residency/fellowship page links out by specialty; public directory is provider-focused.
Large searchable GME catalog across Arizona, Florida, and Minnesota; public directory is provider-focused.

column3: University of Maryland School of Medicine / Medical Center
column9: UMMC GME hub links to residency, fellowship, and current trainee pages. The UMB campus directory is public but requires JavaScript and reCAPTCHA, which may limit automated crawling.
